summary: Tested PASSBOOK Dr/Cr convention, mandatory Rokad party, settings partial PUT, IE quick buttons/Excel, transfer smoke, TB/DayBook regression. Backend 6/6 pytest pass. Frontend: headers, debit/credit column placement, header & CLOSING balance (Cr/Dr), Statement(Print) columns + legends + Dr/Cr, Excel ledger export, Rokad summary, Dashboard widget, Outstanding labels, Day Book, IE quick buttons & Heads sheet all correct. ONE BUG: on-screen PartyLedger per-row running balance and Opening row still use OLD suffix (shows 'CR' for negative, nothing for positive) -> contradicts closing row (e.g. row '₹ 600.00 CR' while closing '₹ 600.00 Dr').

minor.issue: Backend does not resolve party_name from party_id; API-created entries (without party_name) show '—' in Rokad list and 'Receipt · · desc' in cash ledger. UI always sends party_name so only API clients affected.
party_id of whitespace ' ' passes the mandatory check (only falsy check, no strip / existence validation of party_id).

ui_bugs.issue: Uses old convention: `{r.balance < 0 && CR}` -> negative balance shows 'CR' (should be 'Dr'), positive shows no suffix (should be 'Cr'). Repro: party with receipt 1000 + payment 400 -> rows show '₹ 1,000.00 CR', '₹ 600.00 CR' but closing row/header show '₹ 600.00 Dr'. Cash ledger rows show no suffix for positive. Fix: replace with {drcr(r.balance)} / {drcr(opening)} and align colors with balColor.

issues: With empty party the native HTML 'required' tooltip ('Please fill out this field') appears instead of the Hinglish toast; toast only shows when a name is typed but not picked. Entry is correctly not created either way.

action_items: PartyLedger.jsx: replace row-balance and opening-row suffix (`< 0 && CR`) with drcr() so rows show Cr for positive / Dr for negative, consistent with closing row, statement and Excel
Optional: backend create/update rokad should fill party_name from party_id and validate party exists (strip whitespace)
critical_code_review_comments: PartyLedger.jsx row/opening color logic (#1B5E20 for negative) still reflects old meaning; for parties negative = dena now — review colors alongside suffix fix
